mil7.8.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, chattassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.8.3:1.3: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kilesānaṃ uparimuddhani-carena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja chattassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja chattaṃ muddhanupatthambhaṃ hoti,
mil7.8.3:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena yoniso manasikārupatthambhena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja chattassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja chattaṃ vātātapameghavuṭṭhiyo paṭihanti,
mil7.8.3:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena nānāvidhadiṭṭhi-puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ matavāta-tividhaggisantāpa-kilesavuṭṭhiyo paṭihantabbā.
mil7.8.3:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja chattassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.3:3.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
